microarchitecture_summary.implementation_style: Single-module, single-clock, synchronous active-low reset PWM controller with one 8-bit registered counter and one combinational compare output.
microarchitecture_summary.control_strategy: On each rising edge of clk, clear state when reset_n is low; otherwise hold counter_value when enable is low; otherwise increment the counter, rolling over to zero when the current counter_value equals period.
microarchitecture_summary.state_strategy: One 8-bit counter register holds the observable state exposed on counter_value. No additional state elements, FSM state, or memory macros are implied.
microarchitecture_summary.output_strategy: pwm_out is a purely combinational function of counter_value and duty_cycle, asserted when counter_value < duty_cycle. counter_value directly reflects the registered count state.

fsm_intent.description: No explicit FSM is required. The behavior is fully captured by synchronous counter control with reset, enable hold, increment, and inclusive terminal-count rollover.

internal_storage: 8-bit counter register initialized to 8'h00 on synchronous active-low reset
output_mapping: counter_value[7:0] is driven directly from the registered counter state
pwm_out is driven by combinational comparison counter_value < duty_cycle

sequencing_notes: Reset is synchronous and active-low: the counter register clears on a rising edge of clk while reset_n is low.
When reset_n is high and enable is low, the counter holds its current value.
When reset_n is high and enable is high, the counter advances by one unless the present counter_value equals period, in which case the next state is zero.
The rollover comparison uses the current registered counter_value against the combinationally sampled period input.
pwm_out is not registered and updates combinationally with counter_value and duty_cycle.
timing_notes: Single clock domain on clk at 50.0 MHz nominal / 20.0 ns period.
reset_n is synchronous; no asynchronous reset timing is implied.
counter_value should be treated as a registered output with clock-to-out behavior from the internal counter state.
pwm_out is combinational and therefore depends on the propagation delay of the counter register output and duty_cycle input compare.
No multicycle or generated-clock behavior is implied by the spec.
ownership_notes: Owns the internal 8-bit counter state only.
Owns the enable-controlled increment/hold behavior and inclusive terminal-count rollover policy.
Owns synchronous active-low reset clearing of all internal state.
Owns the combinational PWM compare that generates pwm_out from counter_value and duty_cycle.
Exposes counter_value as the direct observable representation of the registered counter state.
consistency_notes: Interfaces remain exactly as defined in digital_spec_json.
No hierarchy, ports, or filenames may differ from digital_spec_json.
